quality_policy.note: Stages are compatibility task labels, not prerequisites. Apply study-appropriate scientific checks. Existing user authorization persists; no fixed paper count, scores, venue floors, mandatory review panel or vendor writing restrictions.

intake.author_task: Clarify the current research goal and only the constraints needed for the next useful action. Reuse user decisions already given; unknown values stay unknown.
intake.hard_floor: Preserve truthful sources, actual results, privacy and existing cumulative spending authority. This task label is not an approval prerequisite.

topic-intelligence.author_task: Read relevant primary work, distinguish importance from novelty, and compare plausible explanations when they affect the research decision. Propose or refine the question from actual evidence; no fixed number of candidates or sources.
topic-intelligence.hard_floor: Preserve truthful sources, actual results, privacy and existing cumulative spending authority. This task label is not an approval prerequisite.

paper-architecture.author_task: Organize the current contribution around a useful question and independently sufficient evidence. Add, merge or retire papers as the research develops; preserve prior work and explain material changes.
paper-architecture.hard_floor: Preserve truthful sources, actual results, privacy and existing cumulative spending authority. This task label is not an approval prerequisite.

experiment-design.author_task: Choose a suitable design, analysis unit, comparisons and uncertainty assessment. Make confirmatory choices before observing their outcomes; label exploration honestly. Use the smallest informative experiment with actual inputs and an authorized budget.
experiment-design.hard_floor: Preserve truthful sources, actual results, privacy and existing cumulative spending authority. This task label is not an approval prerequisite.

experiment-execution.author_task: Execute the appropriate method using available tools and record actual inputs, environment, outputs, failures and costs. Interpret all relevant outcomes, including null or adverse evidence; do not relabel exploration as prospective confirmation.
experiment-execution.hard_floor: Preserve truthful sources, actual results, privacy and existing cumulative spending authority. This task label is not an approval prerequisite.

writing-and-review.author_task: Write around the strongest supported contribution, decisive evidence and limits. Draft alongside research, label missing results, inspect material claims and render the actual deliverable. Review only when it resolves an uncertainty; prepare submission materials for the actual target.
writing-and-review.hard_floor: Preserve truthful sources, actual results, privacy and existing cumulative spending authority. This task label is not an approval prerequisite.
